In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Forgotten War" /> the forces of [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]]'s [[Eriadu Authority]] '''battled''' [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] raiders at [[Chelleya]]. The Eriadu Authority forces, including a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] commanded by [[Shea Hublin]], were victorious, driving the Nagai away from nearby [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
